description: This file defines types, function prototypes, and external references for pattern parsing and evaluation in the lighttpd project. It includes declarations for pattern representation, callback functions, and pattern evaluation functions.

methods.name: li_pattern_new
methods.description: Constructs a new liPattern by parsing a string, returning NULL if parsing fails.

methods.name: li_pattern_free
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a liPattern.

methods.name: li_pattern_eval
methods.description: Evaluates the pattern within a given request context, appending the result to a destination string.

methods.name: li_pattern_array_cb
methods.description: Default callback for handling array of GStrings during pattern evaluation.

methods.name: li_pattern_regex_cb
methods.description: Default callback for handling regex match info during pattern evaluation.

ctags.name: liPatternCB
ctags.pattern: /^typedef void (*liPatternCB) (GString *pattern_result, guint from, guint to, gpointer data);$/
